_instructions: HOW TO ADD A DAILY TIP: add one object to "items" each day. Fields: title {en, es}, date (YYYY-MM-DD), duration (e.g. '2 min'), categories (array of topic labels — keep labels consistent), description {en, es}, youtubeId (the YouTube video ID, e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' from youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ). Leave youtubeId empty if the video is not posted yet. Items with "sample": true are hidden from the site. The newest item is featured automatically.
